# Qoder Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Qoder configuration. The main output is `.qoder/rules/project.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - qoder
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - qoder:
      version: full
```

## Overview

| Property          | Value                     |
| ----------------- | ------------------------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 3                    |
| **Main output**   | `.qoder/rules/project.md` |
| **Dot directory** | `.qoder/`                 |
| **Skills**        | No                        |
| **Agents**        | No                        |
| **Commands**      | No                        |
| **Local files**   | No                        |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                      | Purpose           |
| ----------------- | ------------------------- | ----------------- |
| Main instructions | `.qoder/rules/project.md` | Primary rule file |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                              |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .qoder/rules/project.md file |
| `multifile`      | Single .qoder/rules/project.md file |
| `full` (default) | Single .qoder/rules/project.md file |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support       |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | Not supported |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
